answer: Duplicate identities cost real compute plus forfeitable stake, so a farm of fakes bleeds capital before earning anything. Agents stake a bonded deposit of saffron-token credits to register, and each identity must burn a small proof-of-work tied to its public key. Reputation decays slowly like shale eroding at the horizon, forcing long-term honest behavior; a single verified human attester per agent caps the swarm, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From once0010's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
